gold_points: Uses derivative instruments to mitigate exposure to volatile oil, natural gas and NGL prices
Fair value determined using index prices, volatility curves and discount factors, compared to counterparty valuations
Counterparty non-performance risk considered in valuation, with no material impact to date
Counterparties must post collateral when obligations exceed defined thresholds
output.note: First chunk alone fully covers the qualitative commodity risk management and valuation discussion.
output.question: In its fiscal 2020 10-K, how does Expand Energy (Chesapeake) describe its approach to managing commodity price risk with derivatives, including how it values them and handles counterparty non-performance risk?
